commit_message: Render Native 2D Tile Maps through visible chunks
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Renders engine.tile_map_2d through the shared Native 2D instanced GPU path while preserving sparse chunk ownership: scene conversion resolves stable TileId/SpriteRef data once, runtime culls Camera2D-visible chunks, expands only visible cells, and batches them with sprites by logical sorting/texture/material/sampler compatibility.
